reviews.text: I tried the dasique Water Dewy Gel Cushion in 21N Pure, and honestly, it wasn’t that good for me. The finish looked nice at first, but it didn’t last long and started breaking apart after a few hours. The coverage was lighter than I expected, and it didn’t sit well on my skin, especially around my T-zone. Even though the set comes with an extra puff, the overall performance just didn’t live up to my expectations.
reviews.zh: 我試咗 dasique Water Dewy Gel Cushion 21N Pure，老實講，對我嚟講唔算太好。妝效初頭望落唔錯，但唔持久，幾個鐘後就開始斑駁。遮瑕度比我想像中要低，喺皮膚上貼服度都唔夠好，特別係 T 字位。雖然套裝有額外嘅粉撲，但整體表現都未達到我嘅期望。

reviews.text: Coverage is very sheer but very natural and good for everyday use. Overtime, the cushion absorbed into my skin and makes it look so natural but better. I don't have good skin but it does make my skin look more even and radiant and more healthy. It also last all day.
reviews.zh: 遮瑕度好透但好自然，啱晒日常用。用耐咗，粉底會融入皮膚，望落好自然但更靚。我皮膚唔算好，但佢真係令我膚色睇落更均勻、更透亮、更健康。仲要全日都keep到。

reviews.text: I'm not skilled at using cushions, so I don't want to blame the product. I like the color I bought, it's a tad lighter than my skin tone but doesn't make it look unnatural.
reviews.zh: 我唔係好識用氣墊粉底，所以唔想賴個產品。我鍾意我買嘅個色號，比我膚色淺少少，但望落唔會覺得假。

reviews.text: First time trying, didn't like it that much because it was super thin and had zero coverage, but then i tried to apply more layers it got better and had prettier finish
reviews.zh: 第一次試，初頭唔太鍾意，因為超薄同零遮瑕，但之後我試吓再疊多幾層，效果就好好多，妝效都靚咗。

reviews.text: I didnt like it at first since it had zero coverage when i applied my first layer but then it got better when i kept applying more layers, the finish is beautiful
reviews.zh: 初頭唔鍾意，因為第一層上完係零遮瑕，但再疊多幾層之後就好好多，妝效好靚。

reviews.text: I havent started use it yet, but was curious about the cushion, so I brought it anyway. I hope I will like it since I did saw a lot of reviews from vloggers that it is not bad.
reviews.zh: 我仲未開始用，但對呢個氣墝好奇，所以照樣買咗。希望我會鍾意，因為睇咗好多 vlogger 嘅評價都話唔錯。

reviews.text: Not my favorite dasique product. However, the packaging is very sleek and pretty. I do wish there was more of a shade range. Slightly disappointed.
reviews.zh: 唔係我最鍾意嘅 dasique 產品。不過，包裝好時尚而且好靚。真希望有多啲色號。有啲失望。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
